title: Kra-Dai-speaking peoples - Wikipedia
text: The term Kra-Dai peoples or Kra-Dai-speaking peoples refers collectively to the ethnic groups of southern China and Southeast Asia, stretching from Hainan to Northeast India and from southern Sichuan to Laos, Thailand and parts of Vietnam, who not only speak languages belonging to the Kra-Dai language family, but also share similar traditions, culture and ancestry.
